note: Agent-created parody pitches. They are not research facts, not approved names, and not locked designs. Each one borrows a structure from the cited inspiration ids and avoids the protected name and silhouette.

pitches.nameTh: อัศวินกระด้ง
pitches.roleInWorld: Wild Creature on the tower's market floors
pitches.visualIdentity: A proud shirtless duelist whose wings are two round winnowing fans and whose lance is a rice pestle. The fans are painted with tower stamps, not a copied ghost costume.
pitches.comedyConcept: He patrols because the grain was sorted incorrectly. The fight is mostly him hovering at eye level and lecturing.
pitches.signatureTrait: Flight that only works while both fans agree.
pitches.abilityConcept: Buffets the row with a fan beat. If both fans are blocked, he has to land and fight on foot.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Takes the fans away, or gets the two fans arguing about which way the wind should go.

pitches.roleInWorld: Tower anomaly that founded a one-room nation
pitches.visualIdentity: A translucent green office of a slime wearing a sash and a tiny desk. Citizens are smaller blobs with name tags. Not a named isekai protagonist and not a round mascot face from any game.
pitches.comedyConcept: It was summoned to save the floor and immediately held an election, which it won because it was the only voter who could quorum.
pitches.signatureTrait: Absorbs complaints and files them as citizens.
pitches.abilityConcept: Turns a discarded complaint into a tiny ally blob. The ally does paperwork damage, which is mostly slowing the party down.
pitches.weaknessConcept: A quorum objection. If nobody recognizes the nation, the citizens clock out.

pitches.nameTh: สารวัตรสองทาง
pitches.visualIdentity: A tall clerk in a plain red coat and a featureless visor, holding two stamps. No scissors, no slit mouth, no blood.
pitches.comedyConcept: Every form has two boxes. Both boxes are wrong. The correct action is to hand the form back unsigned.
pitches.signatureTrait: A binary question that punishes either answer.
pitches.abilityConcept: Offers two labeled buffs. Picking one inflicts the matching penalty. Declining both ends the phase.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Refusal. Attacking the coat does less than returning the form.

pitches.nameTh: ปีศาจวันจันทร์
pitches.creatureType: Weekly floor monster that outgrows the room
pitches.roleInWorld: Wild Creature, rotates by tower floor
pitches.visualIdentity: A different cheap mascot each visit, always one size too big for the corridor. Phase two is the same mascot kneeling because the ceiling arrived.
pitches.comedyConcept: It is defeated, files an appeal, and comes back large enough to bump its head.
pitches.signatureTrait: The rematch is a posture problem, not a new species.
pitches.entranceConcept: Announces the day of the week and a union grievance.
pitches.phaseConcept: After the first knockdown it stands up into the next floor and has to fight stooped.
pitches.defeatConcept: It signs the grievance, shrinks back to badge size, and leaves the pen.
pitches.abilityConcept: Phase one is a normal brawl. Phase two's attacks hit a wider row but cannot reach low.

pitches.nameTh: รองแชมป์ถาวร
pitches.roleInWorld: Corrupted Echo of a ranking duel
pitches.visualIdentity: A sharp coat, a second-place ribbon worn like a crown, no scouter, no mask, no red comet. The face is a tower echo, not a copied prince.
pitches.comedyConcept: Lost the exhibition match and moved into the tower until the rematch is scheduled. The schedule is the boss.
pitches.signatureTrait: Refuses to leave after losing, and refuses to win if it would end the rivalry.
pitches.entranceConcept: Reads the party's ranks aloud and is personally insulted by a tie.
pitches.phaseConcept: At half pride, takes off the ribbon and fights harder, then demands the ribbon back.
pitches.defeatConcept: Shakes hands, pockets the ribbon, and books next week without being asked.
pitches.abilityConcept: Copies the last skill type used against it, slightly wrong.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Praising the performance. Sincere applause drops the guard.

pitches.creatureType: Polite tyrant with a stored true body
pitches.roleInWorld: Tower Guardian of a throne that is mostly a waiting room
pitches.visualIdentity: Phase one is a small, neat receptionist with perfect manners and a nameplate that says Acting. Phase two unpacks into a large pale shape that is original: long cuffs, a stamp for a heart, no horns from any manga. The small body was a sleeve.
pitches.comedyConcept: Runs the floor like a front desk. The apocalypse is what happens when someone asks to speak to the manager and the manager is the same person, larger.
pitches.signatureTrait: The first form is a suppression used to save energy and to keep the carpet clean.
pitches.entranceConcept: Asks the party to take a number. The number is 1.
pitches.phaseConcept: When the number is called, the desk folds out into the real body. The voice stays polite.
pitches.defeatConcept: Shrinks back into the nameplate and writes a formal apology that is mostly about the carpet.
pitches.abilityConcept: Phase one seals one party member in a queue. Phase two is wide, slow, and very sorry.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Making it fill out its own form. Bureaucracy is the battery.

pitches.nameTh: เรือไม่จอด
pitches.roleInWorld: Tower anomaly moored to a pier that is not on the map
pitches.visualIdentity: A squat river ferry with lanterns, a destination board stuck on ARRIVING, and a crew of coats with no one in them. Not a barnacled film captain and not a skull-faced pirate.
pitches.comedyConcept: It has been three minutes from the dock for a few centuries. The boss fight is the docking attempt.
pitches.signatureTrait: Any hail makes it try to deliver a message to someone who got off in another century.
pitches.entranceConcept: The horn sounds from a floor that has no water.
pitches.phaseConcept: Phase two is the same ship, closer, still not touching the pier. The gap is the hitbox.
pitches.defeatConcept: A gangplank finally lands. The crew remembers they were going to the market and disperses.
pitches.abilityConcept: Pulls a fighter one step toward the gap. Messages stun whoever they were addressed to, which is never the person currently playing.
pitches.weaknessConcept: A correct pier name. Guessing 'here' does not count.

pitches.nameTh: คู่ขับเถียงกัน
pitches.visualIdentity: A blocky maintenance mech with two cockpits stacked like bunk beds. One pilot wants a miracle beam. The other is reading the fuel gauge. No super-robot chest emblem, no film jaeger silhouette.
pitches.comedyConcept: The machine is powerful and cannot agree on a direction. The party is collateral in a marital dispute between seats.
pitches.signatureTrait: Attacks only happen when both pilots shout the same verb.
pitches.entranceConcept: The mech walks in already mid-argument. The entrance line is a disagreement about whose turn it is.
pitches.phaseConcept: Phase two is one pilot locking the other out. The mech lists to that side and repeats one move.
pitches.defeatConcept: Both pilots storm off. The empty mech sits down and files a maintenance ticket.
pitches.abilityConcept: A shared-mind blast that fizzles into two weaker shots if the pilots disagree that turn.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Talk to one cockpit. A calmed pilot drags the aim off.

pitches.nameTh: งูใหญ่ในท่อ
pitches.roleInWorld: Wild Creature under the Mysterious Tower
pitches.visualIdentity: A long freshwater reptile whose back ridges are valve wheels, asleep in a cistern. When it stands, it is only as tall as the tower's water tank. No dorsal plates from any film, no ape, no atomic breath.
pitches.comedyConcept: It is not invading the city. The tower was built on its nap. Foot traffic is the alarm.
pitches.signatureTrait: Wakes when someone runs a forbidden experiment on the hot water.
pitches.entranceConcept: The floor floods ankle-deep. Then a valve wheel the size of a door turns by itself.
pitches.phaseConcept: Phase two it tries to stand and gets its shoulders stuck in the atrium. The fight becomes the atrium.
pitches.defeatConcept: Someone apologizes and turns the hot water off. It sinks back into the cistern and the towels dry.
pitches.abilityConcept: Washes a whole side one step back. Phase two drops a stuck-shoulder slam that hits everyone in the room and also the ceiling.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Cold water, or a sincere maintenance request. Do not joke about bombs or real disasters.

pitches.roleInWorld: Secret comedy boss, a Tower Guardian on a day off
pitches.visualIdentity: A magnificent felt monster with a visible human ankle and a chest lamp that is just a kitchen timer. The zipper runs from collar to hip and is stuck at the sternum.
pitches.comedyConcept: The scariest thing on the floor is late for a fitting. The timer is how long the wearer can stand the embarrassment.
pitches.entranceConcept: A tiny person waves from inside the mouth, then remembers to roar.
pitches.phaseConcept: When the timer dings, the wearer has to sit down inside the suit. The suit keeps fighting, worse, because nobody is steering the arms.
pitches.defeatConcept: The zipper gives. The wearer steps out, bows, and the suit deflates into a laundry pile.
pitches.abilityConcept: Wide clumsy swipes. After the ding, the swipes hit random squares, including the suit's own foot.
pitches.weaknessConcept: The zipper pull. Helping is a legal attack.

pitches.nameTh: กระจกขอชัดๆ
pitches.roleInWorld: Secret boss in a Sanctuary Order washroom that is not part of the faction
pitches.visualIdentity: An oval mirror on a stand, with a white glove that comes out of the glass to adjust your collar. No blood, no queen, no historical portrait.
pitches.comedyConcept: It will only answer if your name is pronounced to its satisfaction. The horror is elocution.
pitches.signatureTrait: A summon that is mostly a correction.
pitches.entranceConcept: The glove taps the glass three times and asks you to state your name for the minutes.
pitches.phaseConcept: Each failed pronunciation adds a stricter accent mark. The third success ends the fight without a blow.
pitches.defeatConcept: It writes the name neatly, fogs over, and leaves a towel.
pitches.abilityConcept: Reflects the last compliment as an insult until the name is said cleanly.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Clear speech. Smashing the glass makes it start over, which it enjoys.

pitches.nameTh: เพื่อนก่อนอาหาร
pitches.roleInWorld: Wild Creature that attached itself to a lost badge
pitches.visualIdentity: A round tablet-sized animal with a screen for a belly and a coat that gets one size longer each phase. No ears, claws, or color scheme from a virtual-pet franchise. The care rules are original: no rhymes, no second breakfast, no umbrellas.
pitches.comedyConcept: It evolves only when fed, and the party is holding lunch. The rules are posted on its belly and someone will break them.
pitches.signatureTrait: Growth stages tied to a posted diet, not to a copyrighted chart.
pitches.entranceConcept: Beeps like a hungry device from inside someone's pocket.
pitches.phaseConcept: Each feeding adds a longer coat and a new complaint. An umbrella opens indoors and it multiplies into two, both underdressed.
pitches.defeatConcept: It reaches the final coat, decides it is formal enough, and leaves for a meeting.
pitches.abilityConcept: Small nibbles that become coat-flaps covering an ally's eyes. A broken rule summons a copy with worse manners.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Reading the posted rules aloud. The copy cannot stand being corrected.
